stages.prompt: Create a crisp fine PIXEL ART sprite sheet of the EXACT friendly ticket-clerk boy in the reference: tousled angular chestnut hair, round thin BLACK glasses, small friendly smile, blue hoodie with cream mountain emblem, cream shorts, bare calves, BROWN ankle boots touching bare calves (NO white socks), small brown leather shoulder satchel on his anatomical RIGHT side. Keep approved chibi proportions, same face, hair clusters, cuffs, bag and boots, no smooth vector art. Exactly TWO ROWS by FOUR COLUMNS, equal cells, generous 12 percent transparent margins around each complete body, transparent background, no text, labels or ground shadows. Row 1 walks RIGHT, row 2 walks LEFT. Redraw the two sides with correct anatomy and bag ownership: RIGHT-facing view shows the near/right-side satchel and the near RIGHT hand holding its strap; LEFT-facing view sees the boy's left side, so the bag remains on his FAR/right side, mostly occluded behind torso and far hip with only its back edge visible, not swapped to the near hip. Near left arm can swing freely in left-facing row. Each row is one complete FOUR-POSE TWO-STEP WALK cycle, NOT two repeats of one step. Pose 1: NEAR leg and its near shorts opening extend FORWARD heel-first, FAR leg trails behind on toe. Pose 2: NEAR foot supports under hip, FAR knee gently passes forward with its boot lifted a little. Pose 3: OPPOSITE CONTACT, the NEAR thigh and its MAIN VISIBLE SHORTS PANEL extend BACKWARDS to rear toe, and overlap IN FRONT OF the far thigh at the crotch; FAR leg reaches FORWARD to heel contact. Pose 4: FAR foot supports under hip, NEAR knee gently passes forward with its boot lifted a little. Keep the near shorts panel continuously joined to its OWN thigh: near shorts tilt forward at pose1 and BACKWARD at pose3; actual pelvis overlap must reverse, not just boot colors. Subtle weight shifts, short relaxed walking steps, not running, jumping or high-knee marching. Arms gently counter-swing except hand holding bag strap. Same head size, stable body root per cell and shared ground line, complete arms, both connected legs and boots in every pose.
stages.decision: Rejected gray smoke alpha matte and repeated near-leg contacts.
